meta.project: Kata Natan Apa Aja - Jabodetabek Community & Civic Feed
meta.prompt_style: Hybrid: natural-sentence cinematic body + Midjourney/Flux param tail. Drop the tail (everything after the first ' --') when pasting into DALL-E 3 / Sora; keep it for Midjourney and Flux.

recommended_models.video_settings: 5-10 s, 9:16 vertical, 24 fps, motion strength low-medium to preserve handheld realism

factual_notes: All vehicles in Jakarta, Tangerang, Bekasi and Depok wear B plates; only Bogor uses F plates.
Current KAI Commuter livery (since 2020) is red-white-grey; the legacy red-yellow stripe still appears on older sets, so both are plausible but red-white-grey is the safe default for 2026 scenes.

Angkot colors are route-specific: Bogor city angkots are green; Depok KWK units are commonly green-and-white; Tangerang routes mix pale-blue, orange and yellow liveries; Bekasi runs K-numbered KWK routes.
TransJakarta buses are blue (articulated units included); MRT Jakarta trains are white with a red stripe; ojek-online jackets are green (Gojek) or green-dominant (Grab bike).
meta.timestamp_logic: CRITICAL traffic/transit posts cluster at 07:30-09:00 and 17:00-19:30 WIB on weekdays; weekend jams (e.g. Sawangan) peak 09:00-10:30 and port freight queues (Tanjung Priok) peak 12:00-15:00; culinary and lifestyle LOW-VIBE posts cluster 19:00-22:00 WIB; weekend-only content (Car-Free Day, kerja bakti) pinned to Sat Oct 17 / Sun Oct 18, 2026.
meta.coordinate_note: lat/lng are jittered inside the real footprint of each named street or district - accurate enough for map clustering and heatmaps, not survey-grade.
usage_tips: Load posts in mixed urgency order per day to fake an organic timeline: one CRITICAL, then 2-3 MEDIUM/LOW-VIBE interleaved.
For photo prompts in Midjourney, append --no text, watermark, logo if signage text artifacts appear; Flux users should keep prompts as-is.
For video prompts, keep the camera-movement clause near the start - Kling and Gen-3 weight early tokens more heavily.

posts.caption: Lubang di depan lampu merah Ahmad Yani makin dalem, tadi ada bapak-bapak hasil kopling di situ. Tolong ditambal ya kang, motor sampai seret.
posts.prompt: Vertical smartphone photo taken from the seat of a stopped motorcycle at handlebar height on Jalan Ahmad Yani, Bekasi. The left lane is torn open by a deep waterlogged pothole brimming with milky brown water, its crumbling asphalt lip slick with rainbow oil sheen. A broken green underbone scooter with a cracked fairing leans against the kerb beside a striped warung tarp. Beyond it two B-plate container trucks labor past throwing dirty spray, a minibus swerves wide, and a blur of helmets streams through the gap. Flat white monsoon light under an overcast humid sky, wet asphalt glare, kerbstones stained black, sagging electrical wires overhead. Raw citizen-journalism texture: slight motion blur on the trucks, smudged phone lens, faint sensor noise in the shadows, unedited and unglamorous. Shot on an iPhone 14 main camera, 26mm equivalent, mid-morning, honest photojournalism realism. --ar 4:5 --style raw --v 6.1

posts.caption: Trotoar Margonda depan ruko itu udah kayak jalur slalom, rebar keluar semua. Jalan kaki aja ribet, apalagi bawa trolley.

posts.prompt: Dashcam POV video, 7 seconds, from a car nose-deep into a flooded underpass in Tebet, South Jakarta, moving slowly forward in first gear. The headlights throw a long cone across dark water rising up the road sag, its surface pocked by heavy rain; the bow-wave curls around the bumper as the waterline touches the lower grille. Windshield wipers sweep fast and rhythmic against the downpour, streaks smearing the headlights of a bus waiting at the far lip. On the raised pedestrian walkway to the left, a motorbike rider tiptoes his bike along the narrow concrete ledge, one foot down for balance, three more riders parked ahead of him on dry ground. Dim tunnel lighting, sodium-orange walls streaked with grime and old tide lines, spray misting the lens in bursts. The car dashboard glows faintly at frame bottom. Ambient audio: wiper motor, engine laboring, rain drumming on the roof. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, fixed dashcam rig, rain-streaked lens)

posts.caption: Kabut Puncak turun cepet banget pagi ini, indah tapi jalan cuma keliatan lima meter. Slow driver ya, lampu kabut nyala.
posts.prompt: Slow-motion video, 8 seconds, shot from the terrace of a roadside warung at Puncak Pass, Bogor highlands, early morning. Thick white mountain fog rolls steadily down across the valley, swallowing terraced rows of tea plantation on the slope, then the winding road below, where a line of trucks and minibuses crawls upward with yellow fog lights glowing like lanterns inside the cloud. The fog bank moves fast for slow motion, billowing and fraying over the tea bushes, curling around a lone power pole, briefly erasing everything but two headlights. In the foreground: a wet wooden bench, a glass of hot tea fogging, steam from a fritter pan, the vendor silhouette pulling a plastic curtain closed. Cold blue-green palette warmed only by the fog lights and the pan flame. Cozy, chilly, hypnotic. Ambient audio: distant truck engines, drizzle on the tin roof, kettle hiss. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 60 fps slowed, static tripod)

posts.caption: Angin di Thamrin gila banget, payung pada patah, poncho paling aman. Basah kuyup tapi sampai tujuan.
posts.prompt: Handheld phone video, 6 seconds, filmed from under a TransJakarta bus shelter roof on Jalan M.H. Thamrin, Central Jakarta, during a violent monsoon burst. Horizontal rain whips across the wide boulevard in silver sheets, bending the median palm trees hard to one side, their fronds streaming. Pedestrians in clear plastic ponchos run hunched for cover, one umbrella inverted and abandoned, a food-cart owner wrestling his tarpaulin down. Cars pass throwing spray walls off the flooded lane, a blue bus rocks slightly in the gusts, traffic lights smeared to color spots through the rain. Flags and banners on the median snap taut. The camera jolts once as a gust hits the shelter, droplets speckle the lens, autofocus hunts briefly then locks on the bending palms. Grey-green storm palette, downtown towers ghosted by rain haze. Ambient audio: roaring wind, torrent on the awning, muffled honking. (9:16 vertical, 6 s, 24 fps, handheld with real micro-shake, storm audio)

posts.caption: Genangan di pasar Karawaci masih ceper, dagangan diangkat ke peti dulu. Yg mau ke pasar, bawa boots, jangan lupa.
posts.prompt: First-person walking POV video, 6 seconds, of someone in black rubber boots splashing through ankle-deep clear rainwater in a busy traditional market alley in Karawaci, Tangerang. Each step sends rings across the flooded lane and sloshes past stacked crates; ahead, vendors in aprons lift baskets of water spinach, chilies and shallots onto dry wooden crates, one holding his sandal in his hand, another laughing as he films his colleague on his own phone. Blue tarps stretched overhead shed water in long beads and occasional bucket-dumps that make the camera flinch; shoppers roll their trousers and pick paths between stools. Striped awnings, hanging bulbs already lit against the grey, wet cardboard boxes stacked as stepping stones. Camera bobs with a natural walking gait, one small stumble corrected, focus breathing on the nearest basket. Ambient audio: sloshing steps, vendor chatter, rain drumming on tarpaulin. (9:16 vertical, 6 s, 24 fps, walking handheld POV, market ambience)

posts.caption: Dari JPO Cawang: macet merata sampe tol, ojol nyelip-nyelip di sela. Pulang kerja nanti jam 9 deh kayaknya.
posts.prompt: Vertical video, 8 seconds, shot from a pedestrian overpass above the Cawang interchange, East Jakarta, at the end of evening rush hour. The camera pans slowly left to right across an ocean of completely stationary traffic: thousands of cars, buses and trucks stacked bumper-to-bumper over the toll junction and its feeder lanes, headlight rivers white on one side, brake-light rivers red on the other, a few hazard blinkers pulsing. Motorcycle riders thread the sealed gaps at walking pace, helmet lights glinting; one stretches his back at a standstill. Flyover ramps curve overhead stacked in levels, sodium streetlights flicker on, towers behind dissolve into dusk haze, first office windows lighting up. The pan is smooth but human - a tiny pause mid-frame as a rider cuts through. Deep blue-hour palette of red, white and sodium orange. Ambient audio: layered horn murmur, idling engines, one long whistle. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, slow handheld pan, dusk traffic ambience)

posts.caption: KRL dateng di Citayam, gelombang manusia turun-naik semua. Yg nyempil di pintu, hati-hati ya.
posts.prompt: Eye-level handheld video, 7 seconds, standing on a crowded platform at Citayam Station, Depok, during the evening peak. A white-and-red Commuter Line electric multiple unit with grey accents glides in from the right and brakes to a stop, doors sliding open with their chime; a huge wave of commuters steps out - backpacks, helmets clipped to belts, phone screens glowing - while an equally dense crowd pushes in, meeting chest-to-back at every door. A door alarm beeps and closes on a sprinter who laughs and backs out; the attendant whistle cuts the air. Fluorescent platform light mixes with warm dusk from the open platform end, the yellow tactile strip underfoot crowded with toes, the departure board blurred past reading. Handheld realism: the camera jostles as bodies pass, brief occlusion, refocus on the departing train lit windows. Ambient audio: door chime, crowd roar, whistle, departure tone. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, handheld, station ambience)

posts.caption: Dari boncengan di jalur truk Priok: debu, asap, klakson. Napas juga ikut berdebu, untung muka ketutup helm.
posts.prompt: Shaky smartphone video, 7 seconds, filmed by a passenger on the back of a motorcycle stuck behind a long line of massive freight container trucks on a dusty industrial road in Tanjung Priok, North Jakarta. Framed over the rider shoulder: a wall of rust-streaked container doors fills the view, stacked container trucks inching forward, hot exhaust haze rippling off their stacks in the flat afternoon sun, dust drifting gold through the light. The lead truck brake lights flicker; a reverse alarm chirps as one adjusts into a yard gate; the pillion camera wobbles hard over a pothole, finds the driver face reflected in a container steel panel, then pans briefly back to show the queue bending out of sight behind. Sweat-sheen arms, a crumpled delivery bag between the rider feet. Gritty, hot, industrial. Ambient audio: heavy diesel idle, loud air horns, strap slap. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, pillion handheld, industrial port ambience)

posts.caption: Balikan dari SCBD malem ini lancar, gedung-gedung nyala, aspal masih agak basah. Aman buat yang mau pulang malam.
posts.prompt: Smooth POV video, 8 seconds, riding pillion on an ojek-online motorcycle at night through the SCBD district of South Jakarta, chest-mounted camera with gentle stabilization. The rider in a green ojol jacket threads moderate evening traffic at steady speed: slipping a gap between a sedan and a blue bus, braking smoothly at a light that hangs green reflection on wet asphalt, then flowing again between rows of glass towers. The district glows - tower lobbies lit gold, a pedestrian bridge sweeping overhead with LED strips, hedge planters and sculpture gardens blurring past, taillights drawing soft red ribbons. Wind flutters the jacket shoulder, the bike leans once through a wide arc, construction hoarding lights strobe past. Confident, calm, cinematic; motion-blur streaks on the periphery, sharp center. Ambient audio: steady engine hum, wind rush, muffled city bass from a bar. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, chest-mounted POV, light stabilization, night city ambience)

posts.caption: Lampu merah Kalideres mati lagi, Pak Ogah turun tangan. Whistle-nya lebih disiplin dari lampunya, sumpah.
posts.prompt: Handheld video, 7 seconds, from the sidewalk of a chaotic four-way intersection in Kalideres, West Jakarta, where the traffic light hangs dead and dark. In the middle of the junction a local volunteer traffic warden (Pak Ogah) in a worn reflective vest and cap conducts the flow with a wooden stick and a whistle - a sharp trill and a sweep of the stick releases a wave of minibus angkots and motorbikes; trill again, and the cross-flow stops and turns. A bus angles too wide, a truck noses in, riders bunch into a knot then unravel; two pedestrians dart across behind his screen. The broken signal dangles on its wire, dead black against the morning sky; exhaust and haze flatten the distance, roadside warungs steam at the kerb. The camera tilts slightly as the filmer flinches at a close pass. Ambient audio: whistles, engines, horns arguing with each other. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, handheld sidewalk, dense traffic ambience)

posts.caption: Zoom lubang di Kalimalang samping kanal: dua motor selamat, satu mobil masuk. Bunyi bannya dalem banget, hati-hati sini.
posts.prompt: Stationary smartphone video, 6 seconds, filmed from the canal-side pavement on Jalan Kalimalang, Bekasi, beginning wide and digitally zooming onto a large broken pothole at the lane edge beside the drain mouth. The hole yawns open with water still seeping from it; as the zoom tightens, two motorbikes swerve sharply at the last second, one wobbling wide; then a car front tire drops into it with a heavy visible bounce and a dark splash, the driver braking hard, hazard lights blinking. Beyond the hole, the canal green water slides past between concrete walls, a small moored boat knocking gently. Traffic continues relentlessly: a school shuttle, a fruit cart, another rider threading the same trap. The camera dips as the filmer flinches at the tire-drop, auto-exposure pumping once on the bright canal water. Ambient audio: constant traffic, the deep tire thunk, a hiss of brakes. (9:16 vertical, 6 s, 24 fps, static handheld with digital zoom, roadside ambience)

posts.caption: Matsap Ciputat padam separuh jalan, generator kecil pada nyala. Suasananya jadi sinetron jam 7.
posts.prompt: Walking POV video, 7 seconds, down a crowded commercial street in Ciputat, South Tangerang, at night during a local power outage. The right half of the street is pitch black - shuttered storefronts, dead signage, one hand-cranked emergency lantern wobbling - while on the left half shop owners have started small petrol generators on the sidewalk: pull cords yanked, exhaust haze drifting, extension leads running into shops that bloom back to half-light. Vehicle headlights sweep the pavement as cars nose through, briefly lighting faces; a food stall gas flame glows blue where the bulbs died; a customer films on his phone flashlight. The camera walks steadily, boots scuffing, passing close to a generator whose noise dominates for a moment. Contrast is extreme: warm pockets of light in a corridor of darkness, reflections on the road. Ambient audio: two-stroke generators, low murmur, occasional laughter. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, walking handheld, night blackout ambience)

posts.caption: Pipa air Cibinong pecah, semburan sampe dua meter, jalur kiri jadi kolam. Tolong ditindak, air keluar terus.
posts.prompt: Stationary phone video, 6 seconds, filmed from across the street in Cibinong, Bogor Regency, showing a burst underground water pipe at the edge of an asphalt road. A violent geyser shoots two meters into the air from a torn patch of pavement, white water pearling in daylight, wind pushing a mist curtain over the left lane, which has become a spreading shallow lake swallowing the gutter and lapping at the shopfronts. Motorcycles slow to a crawl through the sheet flow, a rider in a rain poncho laughing into his helmet; a car reverses out of the flooded lane; a small crowd gathers at a safe distance, one man filming, an auntie pointing at the road sag. Water glitters in the sun, the asphalt lip visibly crumbling into the hole, the geyser pulsing as pressure shifts. Ambient audio: pressurized spray hiss, slowing traffic, neighborly chatter. (9:16 vertical, 6 s, 24 fps, static handheld, street ambience)

posts.caption: Jalan pelan di terowongan Dukuh Atas, ada yang main gitar, mural-nya keren. Salut buat ruang publik begini.
posts.prompt: Cinematic handheld video, 8 seconds, walking through the revitalized Dukuh Atas pedestrian underpass in Central Jakarta at early evening. The gimbal-smooth camera glides past a long curved wall of colorful murals - wayang silhouettes and river motifs in teal and terracotta - while commuters stream both ways: office shirts, hijabs, a student with a guitar case, two friends sharing earphones. On a small recessed platform a street musician plays acoustic guitar, case open with a few rupiah notes inside, his chords wrapping the tunnel. Warm modern strip lights run the ceiling in clean lines, their glow doubled in the polished terrazzo floor; wayfinding arrows glow soft green; a cool draft stirs a poster corner. The tunnel opens ahead to the lit concourse and dusk beyond. Fluid, human, quietly optimistic urban texture. Ambient audio: clean guitar over footsteps and murmur, a distant train announcement. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, gimbal-smoothed walk, underpass ambience)

posts.caption: Penggalian pipa drainase di Rawamangun, jalan tinggal satu, antrean antar sekolah panjang. Toleransi ya guys.
posts.prompt: Daytime smartphone video, 7 seconds, of roadworks narrowing a street in Rawamangun, East Jakarta, to a single lane. A yellow excavator swings its arm rhythmically, bucket biting a deep trench cut for drainage pipes along the lane, orange-painted steel plates and cones cordoning the dig, stacked concrete pipes and a pile of wet clay spilling onto the shoulder. A flagman in a vest waves the alternating traffic through: first a queue of school shuttles and parents motorbikes picking up kids in white-and-red elementary uniforms, then scooters threading the margin, a bus waiting its turn with indicators blinking. Dust and exhaust hang in the bright sun, a water truck dampens the spoil heap, shop fronts behind shrink behind the machinery. The camera pans from the excavator to the queue and back, autofocus ticking between them. Ambient audio: diesel clatter, reverse beeper, flagman calls, school chatter. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, handheld, construction ambience)

posts.caption: Martabak Pecenongan: keju pake gunungnya, susu kental manis ditetesin borok. Uap-nya tetep yang paling penting.
posts.prompt: Close-up vertical food video, 8 seconds, at a late-night street stall in Pecenongan, Central Jakarta. A vendor in a stained apron works a thick Martabak Manis on a blackened cast-iron griddle: he flips the tall golden pancake with a wrist-flick, paints its surface with butter, grates a generous mountain of orange cheddar over it, follows with a zigzag pour of condensed milk from the tin, and presses it into a round steel tray. Steam rises naturally in the warm tungsten light, sugar glinting, the edges crackling as he cuts it into thick slices with a long two-handled knife, cheese stretching between them. Behind, the stall jars of peanuts and chocolate sprinkles wait in soft bokeh, a queue of faces out of focus, motorbikes passing in light streaks. Appetizing, tactile, unretouched. Ambient audio: griddle sizzle, grater rasp, knife knocks, street murmur. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, static close-up with gentle push-in, street-food ambience)

posts.caption: Keliling Pasar Santa lantai atas, vinyl sama preloved rame banget. Weekend vibes-nya nendang.
posts.prompt: Handheld panning video, 7 seconds, inside the upper floor of Pasar Santa, South Jakarta, on a lively weekend afternoon. The camera pans left to right across a row of independent stalls: crates of vinyl records flipped through by a young man in a bucket hat, a thrift rack of vintage jackets browsed by two friends filming each other, a display of film cameras and cassette decks, a barista pulling espresso at a compact counter, a collector straightening his poster wall. Warm retro lighting - edison bulbs, amber sconces, neon signage dimmed to pastel - washes over painted concrete and plywood fixtures, dust motes drifting in shafts of window light. The crowd is young, chatty, unhurried; a stroller squeezes past the camera with a soft bump. Documentary texture: quick refocus between stalls, slight overexposure near the window, honest handheld sway. Ambient audio: an indie record playing, espresso machine hiss, weekend chatter. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, slow handheld pan, indoor market ambience)

posts.caption: CFD Bundaran HI pagi minggu, sepeda keluarga sama pelari penuh, langit bersih. Jakarta bisa begini kalau hari minggu.
posts.prompt: Wide-angle smartphone video, 8 seconds, of Sunday-morning Car-Free Day at the Bundaran Hotel Indonesia roundabout, Central Jakarta. Hundreds of cyclists, jogging families and inline skaters sweep around the iconic fountain monument, which throws fine mist into the low sun; a peloton of road bikers drafts past, kids on small bicycles wobble along the median, a Zumba crowd bounces in formation on the far carriageway. The skyscraper walls of Sudirman and Thamrin frame the scene, glass facades flashing sunlight, a parked empty city bus at the kerb, its driver drinking coffee on the shelter bench. Balloons drift overhead, a vendor walks the crowd with trays of iced tea. Bright high-key morning rendering, saturated sky, gentle wide-angle edge stretch, motion blur only on the passing peloton. Joyful, civic, unforced. Ambient audio: bicycle bells, a distant Zumba beat, laughter. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, slow handheld arc, Car-Free-Day ambience)

posts.caption: Ngetik deket danau UI, angin sepoi, riaknya adem. Deadline jadi nge-late tapi hati damai.
posts.prompt: Relaxed static POV video, 8 seconds, sitting at a lakeside cafe near the University of Indonesia campus in Depok, mid-afternoon. The camera rests at table height, frame edges showing a glass of iced coffee sweating and a laptop open mid-document. Across the green lake water, gentle ripples catch the light; a heron picks along the far bank, an occasional fish break rings the surface. Students at neighboring wooden tables chat softly and type - one rehearsing a presentation under his breath, a pair sharing earphones and a laugh, a runner walking off a cooldown along the shore path. Tropical trees sway in a light breeze, dropping a leaf onto the deck; sun and cloud shadows alternate in slow waves on the water. Nothing happens; everything is pleasant. Warm greens and teak browns, soft diffused light. Ambient audio: breeze in leaves, quiet conversation, distant call to prayer, water lapping. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, static gimbal, lakeside ambience)

posts.caption: Jalan sore di Pantjoran PIK, gerbang pagoda nyala merah-emas, kukusan dimsum berasap terus. Romantis bener.
posts.prompt: Evening walking-tour video, 8 seconds, through the Pantjoran Chinatown district of Pantai Indah Kapuk 2, North Jakarta, at dusk. The camera glides forward past the grand traditional pagoda gate, its tiers lit deep red and gold against the blue-hour sky, lion statues at its base, lanterns strung in waves overhead down the pedestrian street. Families pose for photos at the gate, a child riding a grandfather shoulders holding a candy; steam rises from dim sum stalls where bamboo baskets stack four-high, a vendor lifting a lid in a fragrant cloud; bubble-tea windows glow, a trinket stall flickers on. Reflections of red lanterns slide across polished paving stones, warm and festive but unhurried. The camera slows once at the steam, then continues under the lantern canopy. Ambient audio: chatter, soft Chinese pop from a shop speaker, steam hiss. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, gimbal-smoothed walk, evening festival ambience)

posts.caption: Dari JPO Tanah Abang: dua damkar coba masuk, penumpang sama motor memadat. Sirene kenceng banget, mohon madya.
posts.prompt: Urgent handheld smartphone video, 7 seconds, filmed from a pedestrian bridge looking down at the market street outside Tanah Abang Block B, Central Jakarta. Two red fire trucks with ladder racks push through a dense crowd of shoppers and parked motorbikes, bar lights strobing across awnings and faces; a uniformed officer runs ahead waving the crowd to part, vendors hauling carts back, motorbikes hopping kerbs to open a lane. Market goods spill to the very edge of the road - garment bundles and rolling racks - and the trucks mirrors pass centimeters from them. The camera follows the lead truck with a fast, nervous pan, then tilts to find faint smoke above the rooftops. Compression of scale, sweat, urgency; the crowd both obstacle and helper. Ambient audio: sirens, shouted directions, whistle bursts, market roar. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, handheld overpass POV, emergency and market ambience)

posts.caption: Golden retriever tanpa pemilik mondar-mandir di taman Alam Sutera, kalung merah tapi gak ada nama jelas. DM ya kalo kenal.
posts.prompt: Short vertical video, 6 seconds, filmed in a green suburban park in Alam Sutera, Tangerang, late morning. A friendly golden retriever wanders alone on the mown grass verge, sniffing a frangipani sapling, a red leash trailing behind it with a small brass tag that glints; its coat is slightly muddy at the legs, tongue out, tail easy and unhurried. The person filming approaches gently at crouch height, camera steadying as they near: the dog lifts its head, ambles over to sniff the lens, ears soft, then flops its chin briefly onto the grass toward the camera. Joggers pass on the path behind, a playground slide in soft focus far back, dappled sun through rain trees, a lake edge glinting beyond. Warm, calm, community-post tone. Ambient audio: birds, a distant playground, a soft hey-there from the filmer. (9:16 vertical, 6 s, 24 fps, handheld crouch-level, park ambience)

posts.caption: Ronda malam kompleks Galaxy tetep jalan, kentongan-nya kompak, kopi item curah. Aman selama begini terus.
posts.prompt: Evening community video, 8 seconds, of a neighborhood night-watch (ronda malam) post in a housing complex in Galaxy, Bekasi. Static camera at eye level: four middle-aged men in sarongs, jackets and peci sit on a bench inside a small wooden guard post strung with one warm bulb, drinking black coffee from enamel cups, a kettle steaming on a small gas ring. In an easy rhythm one of them taps the hanging bamboo kentongan with a short wooden mallet - tok-tok-tok, pause, tok - the sound rolling out over the walls. A visitor on a motorbike slows at the barrier and is waved in with a friendly arm; a cat threads between the bench legs; a logbook and a transistor radio share the table. A moth circles the bulb, a tungsten pool of light against deep blue evening, dew already on the bench rail. Warm, safe, nocturnal. Ambient audio: kentongan rhythm, low conversation, crickets, spoon in cup. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, static with slight handheld breath, kampung night ambience)

posts.caption: Antrean dessert shop di Blok M Square bisa 50an orang, pada bawa kipas mini. Viral emang beda.
posts.prompt: Handheld video, 7 seconds, outside a viral dessert shop at Blok M Square, South Jakarta, in the evening humidity. A snaking queue of more than fifty young people runs down the sidewalk and doubles back behind a planter: matching tote bags, glowing phone screens, a shared bag of fries making its way down the line, half the queue waving portable mini fans, one guy fanning his friend with the shop menu. A staff member in an apron walks the line handing out paper numbers; two friends peel off laughing with boxes in hand; new arrivals jog in from the MRT entrance across the street. Neon storefront glow, warm streetlight, moped headlights passing in the road, heat shimmer even at night. The camera drifts along the queue, tilts briefly to take in its full length, then settles on the dessert window glow. Ambient audio: fan whirs, chatter, a shop jingle, passing mopeds. (9:16 vertical, 7 s, 24 fps, handheld drift, street ambience)

posts.caption: Golden hour di Fatahillah, jontel warna-warni keliling, pengamen patung ikut nimbrung. Kota Tua paling romantis jam begini.
posts.prompt: Golden-hour smartphone video, 8 seconds, panning across the historic Fatahillah Square in Kota Tua, West Jakarta. Warm low sun rakes the cobblestone plaza, gilding the old colonial museum white facade and its row of tall windows; long shadows of lamp posts and banyans stripe the stones. Tourists pedal colorful vintage ontel bicycles across the square - a girl in a floppy hat, two friends racing, a rented tandem wobbling - while a street performer painted silver as a statue holds a pose, then breaks it to wave at the camera, kids cheering. Pigeons burst off the fountain edge, an iced-dessert cart rings its bell, cafe balconies fill with people watching the light go amber. The camera pans smoothly left to right catching all of it, dipping once to avoid a passing bike, sunset flare kissing the lens. Nostalgic, warm, postcard-honest. Ambient audio: bicycle bells, a performers drum, pigeon wings, laughter. (9:16 vertical, 8 s, 24 fps, smooth handheld pan, golden-hour ambience)
